officialRevision: Perform simple and compound queries; Query with range and inequality filters on multiple fields

limits.officialText: Cloud Firestore limits a query to a maximum of 30 disjunctions in disjunctive normal form; this limit is fixed and cannot be changed
limits.notes: Counted on the canonical DNF of the filter. `in` and `array-contains-any` values contribute to this count and have no separate ID.

limits.officialText: You can use at most one array-contains clause per disjunction (or group)
You can't combine array-contains with array-contains-any in the same disjunction
not-in supports up to 10 comparison values
You can't combine not-in and != in a compound query
limits.notes: Replaces the older 'only one not-in or != per query' wording; maximum 0 combinations.

limits.officialText: A query can have a maximum of 10 range or inequality fields
limits.notes: Distinct field count on the canonical filter.

limits.officialText: The sum of filters, sort orders, and parent document path (1 for a subcollection, 0 for a root collection) in a query cannot exceed 100, based on the disjunctive normal form of the query
limits.notes: Exact calculator with a per-component breakdown.
